Type: metal planter with stand
Use: raising an indoor plant off the floor; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: glam, modern, mid-century modern
Materials: metal pot with a patinated finish, gold-finish metal loop stand
Colors: weathered blue-grey, gold
Shape: cylindrical pot held high in a frame of three tall hairpin-loop legs, slim, light and open
Feel: elegant, airy, refined
Goes with: white walls, brass accents, large leafy plants; glam or modern rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Casual Metal Planter and Stand, 20.87"H, Cement Gray and Gold
product.description: This casual planter in cement and gold tones can stand on the floor or on a table to house your favorite plant or fairy garden. The cement-toned planter brings a subtle wash of color to your room, while the open gold stand adds visual interest. 9.84" diameter x 20.87"H 100% iron This casual cement-hued planter in a gold-toned stand looks great with most decors. Wipe clean with a soft, dry cloth.
